# Deploy World Monitor Self-Hosted on Railway

World Monitor global intelligence dashboard, 143 feeds live with no keys

[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/world-monitor-self-hosted)

## About

World Monitor is a real time global intelligence dashboard. One interactive map brings together earthquakes, wildfires, weather alerts, natural disasters, conflict and protest events, ship and flight tracking, GPS jamming, markets, prediction markets, crypto, cyber threats and an AI ranked news digest, with country briefs and an MCP server for agents.

This template runs the complete self-hosted stack from the upstream Docker setup instead of a frontend that forwards to the hosted API. Your dashboard reads from your own Redis, filled by your own relay and seeders. It deploys six services: the World Monitor app (nginx plus the Node API sidecar), a login gateway, the relay that handles live feeds, news RSS and market data, an Upstash compatible REST proxy, Redis with a persistent volume, and a seeders service that refreshes public datasets every 30 minutes. The dashboard arrives populated with no API keys at all: the seeders service runs 143 of upstream's 214 data feeds by default, each one measured on Railway to publish real data without a key. The World Monitor services are built from a pinned fork of upstream (`protemplate/worldmonitor`, branch `railway-stable`), because upstream publishes no images for the self-hosted stack, several security fixes are newer than the last release tag, and following upstream's moving `main` directly would let a broken upstream commit break new deploys. Every secret is generated at deploy and every service is wired over Railway's private network.

## What gets deployed

| Service | Source | Type |
|---------|--------|------|
| worldmonitor | [protemplate/worldmonitor](https://github.com/protemplate/worldmonitor) (branch: railway-stable) | Worker |
| ais-relay | [protemplate/worldmonitor](https://github.com/protemplate/worldmonitor) (branch: railway-stable) | Web service |
| seeders | [protemplate/worldmonitor](https://github.com/protemplate/worldmonitor) (branch: railway-stable) (root: /scripts) | Worker |
| redis-rest | [protemplate/worldmonitor](https://github.com/protemplate/worldmonitor) (branch: railway-stable) (root: /docker) | Worker |
| Redis | `redis:7.4.11-alpine` | Database |
| worldmonitor-gateway | `caddy:2.11.4-alpine` | Web service |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Service | Default | Description |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `PORT` | worldmonitor | 8080 | nginx listen port inside the image (hardcoded upstream). Railway probes $PORT for the /api/sidecar-health healthcheck, so keep it 8080. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | worldmonitor | - | Optional. Model name for LLM_API_URL. |
| `ACLED_EMAIL` | worldmonitor | - | Optional. ACLED account email for conflict and protest data (free for researchers). Set the same on seeders. |
| `LLM_API_KEY` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Optional. API key for LLM_API_URL. |
| `LLM_API_URL` | worldmonitor | - | Optional. Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL (for example http://ollama.railway.internal:11434/v1/chat/completions). A private URL is trusted automatically in docker mode. |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Optional. Groq key for AI summaries and country briefs (free tier at console.groq.com). Anonymous direct-LLM spend is capped by upstream at 50 calls per UTC day per client IP; behind the gateway every visitor shares one bucket. |
| `WS_RELAY_URL` | worldmonitor | - | Base URL of the ais-relay service. It is the relay's PUBLIC https domain on purpose: the API sidecar's SSRF guard blocks private addresses for every host except UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and LLM_API_URL, so a *.railway.internal relay URL would be refused. Upstream production uses the same public-relay topology. |
| `ACLED_PASSWORD` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Optional. ACLED account password (OAuth, tokens auto-refresh). Set the same on seeders. |
| `LOCAL_API_MODE` | worldmonitor | docker | Self-hosted mode: no Clerk/Convex, no cloud fallback, /api/local-* admin routes return 403, and the Redis REST proxy origin is trusted by the SSRF guard. Keep docker. |
| `LOCAL_API_PORT` | worldmonitor | 46123 | Loopback port of the Node API sidecar behind nginx (upstream default). |
| `FINNHUB_API_KEY` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Optional. Finnhub key for equity quotes and symbol search (free tier at finnhub.io). Set the same key on ais-relay and seeders. |
| `WM_SESSION_SECRET` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Signs the anonymous browser session cookie (wms_). Required, at least 32 characters; the container refuses to start without it. Generated at deploy. |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Optional. OpenRouter key, an alternative or fallback LLM provider for summaries and briefs. |
| `RELAY_SHARED_SECRET` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Shared secret the app sends (x-relay-key) on every non-public relay request. References the value generated on ais-relay. |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` | worldmonitor | - | Upstash-compatible REST endpoint of the bundled redis-rest service over the private network. World Monitor only speaks the Upstash REST protocol, never raw Redis. You may point it at a real Upstash database (https) instead. |
| `WORLDMONITOR_VALID_KEYS` | worldmonitor | - | Operator API key(s), comma separated, accepted in the X-WorldMonitor-Key header by the REST API, /api/health (detailed) and the MCP server at /api/mcp. One key is generated at deploy. |
| `LOCAL_API_CLOUD_FALLBACK` | worldmonitor | false | Never proxy to api.worldmonitor.app. Docker mode forces this off anyway. |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` | worldmonitor | (secret) | Bearer token for redis-rest. References the token generated on the redis-rest service. |
| `ENABLE_ALPINE_PRIVATE_NETWORKING` | worldmonitor | true | The image is Alpine (musl); this makes *.railway.internal names resolve for the redis-rest calls. |
| `PORT` | ais-relay | 3004 | Relay listen port (the relay reads PORT and binds all interfaces, IPv4 and IPv6). Railway probes $PORT for /health. |
| `API_BASE_URL` | ais-relay | - | Where the relay's classify loop reads the news digest: this install, not production. |
| `FINNHUB_API_KEY` | ais-relay | (secret) | Optional. Finnhub key for relay market seeding. |
| `AISSTREAM_API_KEY` | ais-relay | (secret) | Optional. aisstream.io key (free) for the live ship-tracking layer. Without it AIS is disabled and every other relay feed keeps working. The relay opens an OUTBOUND websocket, so no inbound port or UDP is needed. |
| `UCDP_ACCESS_TOKEN` | ais-relay | (secret) | Optional. UCDP API token for conflict event seeding. |
| `RELAY_SHARED_SECRET` | ais-relay | (secret) | Required. Authenticates every non-public relay route (x-relay-key). The relay refuses to start without it. Generated at deploy; worldmonitor references it. |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` | ais-relay | - | Bundled redis-rest over the private network. The relay's in-process seed loops (markets, aviation, GPS jamming, risk scores, UCDP, news classification) write here. |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` | ais-relay | (secret) | Bearer token for redis-rest. |
| `UPSTASH_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP` | ais-relay | true | Lets the relay use the plain http private redis-rest URL. Without it every relay seed loop silently no-ops (upstream requires https unless this opt-in is set). |
| `ENABLE_ALPINE_PRIVATE_NETWORKING` | ais-relay | true | The image is Alpine (musl); this makes *.railway.internal names resolve. |
| `MARKET_YAHOO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS` | ais-relay | 900000 | Yahoo market refresh cadence in ms (upstream compose default, 15 minutes). |
| `SEEDERS` | seeders | | `SEED_MODE` | seeders | core | core runs only the SEEDERS list (fast, no keys needed). all runs upstream's run-seeders.sh over every seed script (about 200, slow, heavier on CPU, memory and upstream rate limits). |
| `ACLED_EMAIL` | seeders | - | Optional. ACLED account email for conflict and protest seeding. |
| `EIA_API_KEY` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. EIA key for energy data (free). |
| `FRED_API_KEY` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. FRED key for US macro series (free). |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | seeders | --dns-result-order=ipv4first | Same as upstream's Railway seeder config: some data providers have broken IPv6. |
| `SEED_TIMEOUT` | seeders | 600 | Per seeder wall-clock cap in seconds, so one hung upstream cannot stall the cycle. |
| `SEED_PARALLEL` | seeders | 3 | Seeders run at the same time. Above 3, public APIs such as Open-Meteo start answering 429. |
| `ACLED_PASSWORD` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. ACLED account password. |
| `FINNHUB_API_KEY` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. Finnhub key used by market seeders. |
| `NASA_FIRMS_API_KEY` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. NASA FIRMS key for the wildfire layer (free at firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov). |
| `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` | seeders | (secret) | Optional. Cloudflare Radar token for internet outage data (paid Radar access). |
| `RAILPACK_NODE_VERSION` | seeders | 24 | Node major used to build and run the seed scripts (upstream images use node 24). |
| `SEED_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | seeders | 1800 | Pause between seeding cycles (upstream suggests every 30 minutes). |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` | seeders | - | Bundled redis-rest over the private network; seeders publish datasets here. |
| `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` | seeders | (secret) | Bearer token for redis-rest. |
| `PORT` | redis-rest | 8079 | Listen port of the Upstash-compatible REST proxy (upstream publishes it on 8079). Every route, including /, requires the bearer token, so there is no healthcheck. |
| `SRH_TOKEN` | redis-rest | (secret) | Bearer token every caller must send. Generated at deploy; worldmonitor, ais-relay and seeders reference it as UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN. |
| `SRH_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | redis-rest | - | Optional. Max request body in bytes (upstream default 16777216). Seeders publish payloads up to about 5 MB. |
| `SRH_CONNECTION_STRING` | redis-rest | - | Private connection string to the Redis service (password auth, includes port). |
| `ENABLE_ALPINE_PRIVATE_NETWORKING` | redis-rest | true | The image is Alpine (musl); this makes redis.railway.internal resolve. |
| `REDIS_PASSWORD` | Redis | (secret) | Redis AUTH password (--requirepass). Generated at deploy; redis-rest references it. |
| `REDIS_MAXMEMORY` | Redis | 256mb | Memory cap with allkeys-lru eviction, as upstream compose runs it. Raise it (and the service memory) if you enable SEED_MODE=all. |
| `PORT` | worldmonitor-gateway | 8080 | Port the gateway listens on; Railway's healthcheck and the public domain both use it. |
| `UPSTREAM` | worldmonitor-gateway | - | Private address of the worldmonitor service (nginx on 8080). |
| `UI_PASSWORD` | worldmonitor-gateway | (secret) | Password for the World Monitor login prompt. Generated at deploy; change it here at any time and redeploy the gateway. |
| `UI_USERNAME` | worldmonitor-gateway | (secret) | Username for the World Monitor login prompt (HTTP basic auth). |
| `PUBLIC_DASHBOARD` | worldmonitor-gateway | false | Set to true to remove the login prompt and serve the dashboard publicly. Anonymous visitors can then trigger LLM summaries and data API calls on your keys (upstream per-IP caps still apply). |

## Configuration

- **Start command:** `sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/start.sh && exec sh /tmp/start.sh'`
- **Healthcheck:** `/api/sidecar-health`
- **Healthcheck:** `/health`
- **Networking:** Public domain with automatic HTTPS
- **Start command:** `sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/seeders.sh && exec sh /tmp/seeders.sh'`
- **Start command:** `sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/start.sh && exec sh /tmp/start.sh'`
- **Start command:** `sh -c 'exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --maxmemory "$REDIS_MAXMEMORY" --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --save 60 1 --dir /data --bind :: 0.0.0.0'`
- **Volume:** `/data`
- **Start command:** `sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/start.sh && exec sh /tmp/start.sh'`
- **Healthcheck:** `/gateway-health`
